All are revenue/classification disputes with the company as appellant or respondent; no criminal proceedings, no fraud or economic-offence case found. Per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds and are noted neutrally: 'есть сложности' — the company litigates customs and tax positions. NEWS/RISK: nothing adverse located. Overall: no rejection grounds under project rules; company appears to be an established Hyderabad-based pharma/chemicals manufacturer with a long history of customs and tax appeals.
